series.title: Python to AI Engineer
series.audience: Beginner developers progressing toward production AI engineering

phases.title: Python Fundamentals
phases.goal: Build a reliable mental model of Python syntax, data, control flow, and reusable programs.

topics.title: How Python Runs Your Code
topics.objective: Explain source code, bytecode, the interpreter, and runtime errors.

topics.title: Python Variables and Data Types
topics.objective: Distinguish names, values, mutability, and common built-in types.

topics.title: Python Operators Without Confusion
topics.objective: Use arithmetic, comparison, logical, identity, and membership operators correctly.

topics.title: If, Elif, Else and Loops
topics.objective: Trace decisions and repetition through a Python program.

topics.title: Python Functions and Parameters
topics.objective: Explain function inputs, return values, scope, and reusable behavior.

topics.title: Lists, Tuples, Sets and Dictionaries
topics.objective: Choose the correct Python collection for ordering, uniqueness, and key-value lookup.

topics.title: Python Comprehensions
topics.objective: Build readable list, set, and dictionary comprehensions without hiding logic.

topics.title: Python Modules and Packages
topics.objective: Explain imports, module boundaries, packages, and reusable project structure.

topics.title: Python Errors and Exceptions
topics.objective: Differentiate syntax errors, runtime exceptions, handling, and cleanup.

topics.title: Files, Paths and JSON in Python
topics.objective: Read and write files safely and serialize structured data as JSON.

topics.title: Python OOP Fundamentals
topics.objective: Explain classes, instances, methods, inheritance, and composition.

topics.title: Virtual Environments and Dependencies
topics.objective: Isolate dependencies and make Python projects reproducible.

phases.title: Advanced Python
phases.goal: Write idiomatic, concurrent, testable, and maintainable Python for production services.

topics.title: Python Decorators Explained
topics.objective: Show how decorators wrap callables and add reusable behavior.

topics.title: Iterators and Generators
topics.objective: Explain lazy iteration, yield, and memory-efficient data pipelines.

topics.title: Python Context Managers
topics.objective: Use with, resource cleanup, and custom context managers safely.

topics.title: Type Hints That Actually Help
topics.objective: Use annotations, protocols, generics, and static checking effectively.

topics.title: Dataclasses vs Pydantic
topics.objective: Choose between internal data containers and validated boundary models.

topics.title: Async and Await in Python
topics.objective: Explain event loops, coroutines, awaiting I/O, and when async improves throughput.

topics.title: Threads vs Processes vs Asyncio
topics.objective: Choose concurrency based on I/O-bound and CPU-bound workloads.

topics.title: Testing Python with Pytest
topics.objective: Structure unit tests, fixtures, mocks, and integration tests.

topics.title: Production Logging in Python
topics.objective: Create structured, contextual, and actionable application logs.

topics.title: Python Performance Basics
topics.objective: Measure bottlenecks before optimizing memory, algorithms, and I/O.

phases.title: FastAPI and MySQL
phases.goal: Build secure asynchronous APIs backed by well-designed relational data.

topics.title: How a FastAPI Request Works
topics.objective: Trace routing, validation, dependency injection, execution, and response serialization.

topics.title: FastAPI Validation with Pydantic
topics.objective: Validate request and response boundaries with explicit schemas.

topics.title: FastAPI Dependency Injection
topics.objective: Reuse authentication, database, and service dependencies cleanly.

topics.title: Async FastAPI Endpoints
topics.objective: Use asynchronous endpoints without blocking the event loop.

topics.title: Authentication in FastAPI
topics.objective: Explain password hashing, tokens, authorization, and secure dependencies.

topics.title: Background Tasks, SSE and WebSockets
topics.objective: Choose the right pattern for deferred and real-time FastAPI work.

topics.title: MySQL Data Modeling
topics.objective: Design tables, relationships, constraints, and normalized data.

topics.title: SQL Joins Visually Explained
topics.objective: Trace inner, left, and self joins across related tables.

topics.title: How MySQL Indexes Work
topics.objective: Explain index lookup, selectivity, composite indexes, and tradeoffs.

topics.title: MySQL Transactions and Isolation
topics.objective: Explain atomic changes, rollback, locking, and isolation anomalies.

topics.title: Async SQLAlchemy with FastAPI
topics.objective: Manage sessions, transactions, repositories, and async queries safely.

phases.title: LLM Fundamentals
phases.goal: Understand how language models represent input, generate output, and fail.

topics.title: Tokens and Context Windows
topics.objective: Explain tokenization, context limits, latency, and cost.

topics.title: Prompts vs System Prompts
topics.objective: Separate task instructions from application-level behavior and constraints.

topics.title: How LLM Inference Works
topics.objective: Trace next-token prediction through the generation loop.

topics.title: Temperature, Top-p and Top-k
topics.objective: Explain how decoding controls alter token selection.

topics.title: Embeddings and Semantic Similarity
topics.objective: Explain vector representations, distance, and similarity search.

topics.title: Why LLMs Hallucinate
topics.objective: Explain probabilistic generation and practical reliability controls.

topics.title: Structured Output and Tool Calling
topics.objective: Constrain model output into schemas and validated application actions.

topics.title: LLM Guardrails and Evaluations
topics.objective: Separate preventive controls from measurable quality evaluation.

phases.title: RAG Systems
phases.goal: Ground model responses in retrievable, attributable, and evaluated knowledge.

topics.title: How RAG Works
topics.objective: Trace ingestion, retrieval, context assembly, and grounded generation.

topics.title: RAG Chunking Strategies
topics.objective: Choose chunk boundaries, overlap, and metadata for retrieval quality.

topics.title: Vector Databases for RAG
topics.objective: Explain indexing, filtering, similarity queries, and persistence.

topics.title: Hybrid Search and Reranking
topics.objective: Combine lexical and semantic retrieval, then rerank candidates.

topics.title: Grounded Answers with Citations
topics.objective: Connect claims to retrieved evidence and expose uncertainty.

topics.title: How to Evaluate RAG
topics.objective: Measure retrieval relevance, faithfulness, completeness, and end-to-end usefulness.

topics.title: Production RAG Architecture
topics.objective: Design ingestion, serving, observability, caching, access control, and evaluation loops.

phases.title: AI Agents and Agentic RAG
phases.goal: Build agents that select tools, manage state, recover from failure, and retrieve iteratively.

topics.title: How AI Agents Work
topics.objective: Explain goals, state, reasoning, tools, observations, and stopping conditions.

topics.title: Tools and Function Calling
topics.objective: Design constrained tools, schemas, results, and error handling for agents.

topics.title: AI Agent Memory
topics.objective: Separate working context, episodic memory, semantic memory, and durable state.

topics.title: Planning and Reflection in AI Agents
topics.objective: Explain when agents should plan, act, inspect, and revise.

topics.title: How Agentic RAG Works
topics.objective: Show how an agent reformulates, retrieves, evaluates, and repeats before answering.

topics.title: Orchestrating AI Agents
topics.objective: Compare sequential, parallel, supervisor, and event-driven agent workflows.

topics.title: Multi-Agent Systems
topics.objective: Decide when role specialization improves a workflow and when it adds overhead.

topics.title: Reliable AI Agents
topics.objective: Use budgets, permissions, idempotency, tests, retries, and human review.

topics.title: Context vs Harness Engineering
topics.objective: Separate what the model sees from how the surrounding agent system executes and recovers.

phases.title: Small Models and Fine-Tuning
phases.goal: Choose, adapt, evaluate, and deploy models for a concrete product constraint.

topics.title: Small Language Models
topics.objective: Explain where smaller models win on cost, latency, privacy, and specialization.

topics.title: RAG vs Fine-Tuning
topics.objective: Choose retrieval or adaptation based on knowledge, behavior, cost, and update frequency.

topics.title: Fine-Tuning Dataset Design
topics.objective: Create representative, clean, diverse, and leakage-resistant training examples.

topics.title: LoRA and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
topics.objective: Explain adapters, rank, training efficiency, and deployment tradeoffs.

topics.title: Evaluating and Deploying Fine-Tuned Models
topics.objective: Compare the adapted model against baselines before safe deployment.

phases.title: Edge AI and Physical AI
phases.goal: Run intelligent systems under real-world latency, compute, sensing, and safety constraints.

topics.title: Edge AI Fundamentals
topics.objective: Explain local inference, latency, privacy, connectivity, and device constraints.

topics.title: Model Quantization
topics.objective: Explain lower-precision weights, memory savings, speed, and quality tradeoffs.

topics.title: Building an On-Device AI Pipeline
topics.objective: Trace capture, preprocessing, inference, postprocessing, and telemetry on constrained hardware.

topics.title: Physical AI Fundamentals
topics.objective: Connect perception, world models, planning, control, and feedback.

topics.title: The Perception-to-Action Loop
topics.objective: Trace sensor input through estimation, planning, actuation, and feedback.

topics.title: Safety for Physical AI
topics.objective: Explain simulation, constraints, redundancy, monitoring, and safe fallback behavior.

topics.title: AI Engineer Capstone Architecture
topics.objective: Combine FastAPI, MySQL, RAG, agents, evaluation, and deployment into one production system.
